youtube.aciklama: The otoscope light reflects off the tympanic membrane (eardrum) and forms a bright triangle. This light reflex appears in the anterior inferior quadrant, at 5 o'clock in the right ear and 7 o'clock in the left ear.

sahneler.metin: What *time* does the eardrum's light triangle show?
cumleler: What time does the light triangle on the eardrum show?
The otoscope light reflects off the eardrum as a bright triangle.
In the right ear, this light reflex points to five o'clock.
In the left ear, it points to seven o'clock.
Both are in the anterior inferior quadrant of the eardrum.
This also helps confirm which ear you are looking at.
